guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: recommendationservice is the only service with large anomalies: diskio went from 0 to 9.26e9 (the largest z by far), alongside latency-90 +1641%, mem +886% and cpu +649%, while its callee productcatalogservice and other services are essentially flat. Disk I/O is the most extreme and the baseline-zero signal, but the mem and cpu rises could also indicate a mem or cpu fault, and the logs are empty and the worst traces mostly don't show recommendationservice, so the fault type is not fully certain.

proposed_fix.description: Investigate and throttle the I/O source on recommendationservice (e.g., check for runaway disk writes or log/cache dumping), then restart or reschedule the affected pod if I/O remains saturated; no data deletion.
